verdicts.rationale: Commit 3c8bc9447b added `@retry(attempts=3, backoff=0.2)` to `services/orders/http_client.py`. Introducing 3 retry attempts with a 0.2s (200ms) backoff on HTTP client calls directly causes the observed increase in outbound request duration from orders to inventory (p95 increased from 300ms to 610ms), which in turn drives up GET /api/orders p95 latency.

Commit abc1a46fb0 updates the httpx dependency from 0.27 to 0.28 in `poetry.lock` and `pyproject.toml`. While HTTP client changes can affect network calls, there is no direct evidence of a performance regression in httpx compared to the added retry backoff loop.
Commit b9cb59ea6b only adds test code in `services/orders/tests/e2e.py`. Test code does not execute in production endpoint request paths and cannot cause runtime API latency.
